title: Youtubers Ingame
body:
# **What is this mod?**
- It brings popular youtubers to the game!
- It adds for example Dream, BastiGHG or Technoblade!
- You can play with friends!
- They are passive mobs so be careful, don´t hit them they will fight back!
## **Why should you download this mod?**
- It´s very funny with friends
- It makes you feel as if you were in a youtube video of them!
